annotations.title: Find youth drills by sport and age

description: For parents, coaches and trainers (adults). Free SSTracker drills open at a child's age (the app's own age gates: contact, tackling, heading and advanced drills wait for their age), each with steps, minutes, a safety line and its page link.

at_home.description: Only drills that work at home.

skill.description: Optional: one of the sport's skills, e.g. "shooting".
